verdict: No static blocker for the bounded monotone-mask change; empirical preservation, ownership, source crop and corpus gates remain required. No production approval is implied.
scope: Read-only code review and textual/source-hash assertions. No detector, corpus, synthetic test, or helper implementation was run.

verifiedAssertions.onlyFunctionalChange: One assignment, ink = musicalFeatureInk, before the measured erasure loop. Removing its three-line hunk reproduces e32 exactly.
verifiedAssertions.nominalMaskLoop: The candidate nominal feature-mask loop is text-identical to production after renaming musicalFeatureInk to ink.
verifiedAssertions.connectorDecisionLoop: The full candidate connector loop is text-identical to production after normalizing its two legacy feature-mask reads and the synchronized false-only cut into both masks.

proof: Let N be the established nominally erased feature mask and S the measured structural mask, for one invocation and fixed retainMusicalEvidence value. At candidate line172, S=N. Every measured-mask write at lines207/211 only clears a pixel. Every later connector cut at lines694/695 clears the same pixel in both masks. No later write adds ink. Therefore S is a pixel subset of N at connected-component labeling.

Both masks use the same source raster dimensions and the same eight-connected run-labeling convention. Consequently every raw S component lies entirely inside exactly one raw N component. Its bounding box lies within that parent box, so the vertical bounding-box staff-owner test cannot gain an owner relative to that raw parent.

Connector support, staff-core tests and branch decisions continue reading the untouched original mask. The two terminal-body flood-fill reads use N; its initial nominal erasure matches production, and every accepted connector cut mutates N exactly as production mutates its old ink. By induction over connector traversal, musical head vetoes, structural cuts and preservedMusicalConnection decisions stay production-equivalent on fixed inputs. S is never read by those decisions.

The true/false retainMusicalEvidence branches each satisfy this invariant independently. Recursion remains at most one additional false branch. The final ordinary results come from the established local branch when preservation alternatives exist; the additional assignments do not create new recursion or ownership flags.
limitations: The subset result concerns raw mask components. Published components can differ because the later thin multi-owner connector filter can reject a parent while retaining a smaller child; do not claim set containment of final component records.

Component splitting can change detached-mark selection, neighborhood relationships, warnings and crop geometry. The planner also applies flagged legacy envelopes after ordinary selection, so pixel-mask monotonicity does not prove crop or whole-neighbor monotonicity.

Additional erasure can fragment true notation. Existing musical ownership controls and frozen source obligations remain mandatory; a historical single-owner envelope is preservation support, not semantic proof that every excluded pixel is staff ink.

Swift array assignment preserves value semantics. This creates no new shared-mutation hazard; later writes can incur normal copy-on-write memory cost. No independent runtime or memory benchmark was performed.

Cancellation checks and work structure are unchanged from e32. The new assignment itself does not introduce an unbounded loop; current per-page scanning and mapping retain their previously documented bounded cancellation gaps.
reviewPrioritizationRecommendation: Reuse exact previously reviewed crop areas only under matching source/raster, page geometry and staff-identity bindings. A superset contains the previously reviewed target area but requires a separate cleanliness assessment of added ink.

For contractions inspect the actual source region oldCrop minus newCrop, not the analysis-mask difference. Only skip a margin when original unthresholded source/output pixels show it is blank with outward pixel rounding; never use the detector threshold of190 to certify blankness.

Use component provenance to order the queue: newly excluded single-owner ink, shared headings and detached marks first. Every other nonblank exclusion still needs source interpretation; the monotone mask is not a waiver.
Group multiple changed edges from one page/system into one source panel while recording a result for every affected band. Keep small heading/serif exclusions even when the geometric change is tiny.
Keep preservation, added-neighbor cleanliness, unresolved staff assignment and final output layout as separate reported outcomes.
